iDM3 now updates itself. The Overview page shows when a new version is available and what changed in every version since yours, and installs it with one click in a few seconds. Projects and settings are kept.
Updates can also be installed automatically whenever iDM3 is closed. The option is on the Overview page and is off by default.
An update keeps the functions and preferences the user created or changed; everything else comes from the new release.
Device firmware published by ELKO EP can be downloaded from the Overview page.

The Overview page says when a newer version of iDM3 has been published.
Announcements and release notes are published, so they can be updated without a new version of iDM3.
The Overview page shows release notes for iDM3 and for the published firmware.
The version is shown as 3.6.5 rather than with the generated build number after it.
Unit definitions, parameters and enumerations are published, so a new device type no longer needs a reinstall.
Fixed an update that reported itself as ready after every restart.
The Overview page replaces the dashboard: announcements, version and update status, and a link to the user manual.
Device firmware and language files are downloaded from the published catalogue instead of shipping inside the installer.
Added the IBWL3-02B and IBWL3-20B relays.
Added DALI-2 input device support.
